verdict.rationale: Snowflake's own docs list official developer surfaces to build against. These include the Snowpark API for Python, Java and Scala, and official drivers for JDBC, ODBC, Python, Go and Node.js. Snowflake also publishes OpenAPI-compliant REST API specs so developers can build integrations in the language of their choice. The 404s on docs-site OpenAPI paths do not contradict this, since the specs are published in the official GitHub repo. Missing for 10: in-depth SDK documentation beyond one-line index mentions (versioning, coverage of the REST resource APIs in each SDK), and independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Snowpark API for Python, Java, and Scala — process data at scale inside Snowflake.
UDFs, stored procedures, drivers (JDBC, ODBC, Python, Go, Node.js), SQL API, logging, tracing, and extensibility.
Snowflake REST APIs enable developers and partners to use the language of their choice to build integrations with Snowflake using the openAPI specifications.
